changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE users ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), email VARCHAR(25) NOT NULL UNIQUE, password VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, firstname VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, lastname VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW() ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_users_email ON users (email);
changeSet.comment: Create table users with unique email
